Author: MusicManBowls, kihtli
Name: Hunt Helper Evolved
Punchline: Standalone hunt scouting, private-group sync, spawn windows and live mark tracking.
Description: Standalone hunt tracking for FFXIV: scout and share trains, track S/A-rank windows, map possible S-rank spawn points, view live marks and pool trigger-mob kills with a private group. Includes native train reports, lifetime hunt tallies and optional Lifestream travel.
